proposed_from.topic: Honest-width frontier for horizon-adaptive nested donor pools in staggered synthetic controls. Fix finite treated units and horizons, deterministic adoption dates, observed predictors x_i, and deduplicated unit-calendar-time untreated outcomes with conditional means m_it=x_i' beta_t+r_it, ||beta_t||<=L, |r_it|<=delta/2, and known Gaussian covariance Sigma_Q with eigenvalues in a fixed positive band. For each treated j and horizon h let D_jh={i:T_i>T_j+h}. Among deterministic linear-SC rectangular bands whose weights and half-widths depend only on fixed design/model inputs, define W_nested by horizon-specific support D_jh and W_deep by common support D_jK, under uniform joint 1-alpha coverage. Characterize W_nested up to universal constants using a fixed-Bonferroni bias-plus-standard-error SOCP, prove a matching lower bound and finite-sample coverage, prove W_nested<=W_deep, and give a necessary-and-sufficient primal-dual certificate for strict improvement valid on degenerate active faces. Treat correlated Gaussian-max calibration only as a post-solve refinement. Consumers are scpi and augsynth::multisynth. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: The prediction error was derived as one observable worst-case bias radius plus a Gaussian contrast on the deduplicated unit–calendar-time vector. With a fixed Bonferroni multiplier, minimizing the maximum bias-plus-standard-error envelope under simplex and nested-support constraints is a genuine SOCP with finite-sample simultaneous coverage; correlated Gaussian-max calibration is only a post-solve refinement. Each contrast retains a unique treated coordinate, so its contrast Gram matrix is at least the identity and the covariance is uniformly bounded below by sigma_min. Together with coordinatewise attainable bias shifts and an Anderson Gaussian-cube bound, this yields a finite constant-factor comparison between the SOCP envelope and exact robust width, subject to formal verification. Nested feasible-set inclusion proves width cannot worsen. In the two-horizon witness, optimized early nested weights (50/51,1/102,1/102) give variance 101/5100 versus 51/100 for deepest-pool support, with common second-horizon variance 3/200; exact 95% simultaneous full widths were computed as 0.593131 versus 2.799389. No collision was found with CFPT, partially pooled staggered synthetic controls, scpi/multisynth, or Cao–Lu–Wu. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove a necessary-and-sufficient nested-primal/deep-dual strict-gap certificate that remains valid on degenerate active faces, using relative-interior strong duality and interval-certified positive gaps. EARLY KILL TEST: Formalize the covariance-domination/Anderson sandwich and the finite Gaussian-quantile ratio bound; pivot if any legal deduplicated design with fixed eigenvalue bounds violates either inequality or makes the ratio diverge.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest donor-pool paper is used only to anchor shrinking donor eligibility and the common deepest-support geometry; no dominance claim is made against its partially pooled estimator. The closest inference paper supplies valid simultaneous conic prediction intervals without optimizing honest width across horizon-specific supports. The new objects are the exact deterministic linear-band frontier \(W_s\), a computable rational SOCP \(\Gamma_s\) within a dimension-uniform factor of it, and a finite algebraic strict-gap certificate problem that remains meaningful after facial reduction. The explicit staggered witness shows how the fixed-pool restriction discards a valid early untreated observation and yields a certified positive \(\Gamma\) gap.

seed_details.seed: Dimension-uniform honest-width frontier for nested donor simplexes
seed_details.anchor_locator: Section 2, the paragraphs defining \(\mathcal D_{jk}\), and Theorems 1--2 with their appendix proofs.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace pre-treatment fit minimization by the exact support function of the bounded conditional-mean class, then lift the scalar Gaussian bias--variance argument to a deduplicated maximum of contrasts.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for horizon-specific or nested donor pools combined with minimax or honest confidence-band width found no theorem solving this target--method pair.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from ArmstrongKolesar2018 because each coordinate is a scalar Gaussian linear functional.
seed_details.rebuttal: The scalar result does not control one jointly honest rectangle whose coordinates occupy different nested simplex faces; the missing lower step is the covariance-sensitive maximum bound after weight optimization.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The claim is uniform over the full fixed-design class and includes an upper procedure and lower comparison, not a single witness or bare application.

seed_details.seed: Degeneracy-safe iff certificate for strict nested-support gain
seed_details.anchor_locator: Section 2 donor-pool restriction and Appendix A.4 dual characterization of partially pooled weights.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: After feasible-set inclusion gives weak dominance, replace ordinary KKT comparison by facial reduction to the minimal product-cone face before dualizing the deepest-pool program.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for strict donor-support value tests, degenerate SOCP active faces, and synthetic-control facial reduction found only generic conic duality sources.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from strong duality because a nested primal value below a deep dual value certifies a strict gap.
seed_details.rebuttal: Sufficiency is immediate, but necessity fails without dual attainment; zero weights and redundant columns can destroy Slater, so the complete iff statement requires minimal-face duality and a finite-precision separation argument.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The statement asks for both directions and explicitly covers nonunique degenerate faces.

seed_details.seed: Finite price of Bonferroni relative to correlation-aware Gaussian rectangles
seed_details.anchor_locator: Section 4.4 on simultaneous prediction intervals and Supplemental Appendix S.2.2 on alternative calibrations.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the maximal-inequality upper calibration by an Anderson lower comparison using the identity component of the deduplicated contrast Gram matrix.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches pairing optimized synthetic-control weights with Gaussian rectangle quantile ratios found generic Gaussian-max comparisons but no donor-geometry theorem.
seed_details.red_team: Bonferroni can be arbitrarily conservative as the number of coordinates grows.
seed_details.rebuttal: The legal staggered contrast matrix has \(AA^{\top}\succeq I\); covariance-band nondegeneracy forces an independent Gaussian component, while both Bonferroni and exact cube quantiles grow at the same \(\sqrt{\log M}\) scale.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The frontier is derived from observable contrast geometry and includes both calibration directions.

seed_details.seed: Unknown dependent covariance with plug-in nested-width optimality
seed_details.anchor_locator: Theorem 1 and Section 6.2.4 on covariance replacement, together with CattaneoFengTitiunik2021 Appendix A.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Make the SOCP solution map random and prove uniform stability under a shared-cell serial or cluster covariance estimator before applying Gaussian-max comparison.
seed_details.destination_search: The adjacent panel MNAR proposal records that shared-cell covariance consistency and selected-score stability were not proved.
seed_details.red_team: CFPT already allows estimated covariance and weak dependence.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their high-level replacement condition does not establish oracle-width stability for covariance-selected horizon-specific weights, but this extension is too large to combine with the finite-sample known-covariance kernel.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: This is a genuine random-optimization limit-law problem, but it would obscure the current finite-sample frontier.

seed_details.seed: Oracle honest-width support selection under noisy pretreatment scores
seed_details.anchor_locator: Sections 4.2 and 6.3 on data-driven tuning and local constraint geometry.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace supplied donor sets by a joint score--effect local experiment and make coverage uniform over the union of selected nested support faces.
seed_details.destination_search: Cerulli2024 selects donors for pretreatment RMSPE, while the prior close-group run shows that exact-score conditioning cannot represent root-sample local ties.
seed_details.red_team: Sample splitting plus a union bound gives the oracle result routinely.
seed_details.rebuttal: Near-tie support faces create nonregular excess width and the split selector need not attain the best deterministic width; nevertheless, the required local experiment belongs in a separate proposal.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The proposed region is a root-sample local class rather than one hand-tuned noisy-score law.

seed_details.seed: Conformal inversion with horizon-varying not-yet-treated donor orbits
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction and Section 4.4, which contrast their prediction intervals with conformal strategies.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Construct a permutation action that preserves the staggered nested-support prediction residual vector before inverting a maximum conformity score.
seed_details.destination_search: Existing conformal synthetic-control work relies on time symmetry or a specified effect path; changing donor eligibility breaks the obvious orbit.
seed_details.red_team: Chernozhukov, Wüthrich, and Zhu already give exact conformal synthetic-control inference.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their symmetry does not automatically preserve horizon-varying donor supports, but no defensible exact group action was found under deterministic staggered adoption.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed was rejected rather than assuming exchangeability merely to obtain finite-sample coverage.

seed_details.seed: Semiparametric efficiency bound for aggregate staggered effects under nested donors
seed_details.anchor_locator: Sections 3.2--3.4 on optimal affine intervals and efficiency bounds.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the scalar fixed-regression functional by a cohort-weighted event-time contrast and characterize its tangent-space projection under nested donor availability.
seed_details.destination_search: Adjacent synthetic-control papers study asymptotic aggregate effects, but the supplied model fixes finitely many Gaussian cells and known covariance.
seed_details.red_team: The efficiency bound is just the variance of the best linear unbiased contrast.
seed_details.rebuttal: That objection holds in the present finite Gaussian experiment, so a semiparametric efficiency lane would require a materially different growing-panel model.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed was rejected as a relabeling rather than padded into the proposal.

seed_details.seed: Growing-horizon limit law for the optimized nested-donor maximum
seed_details.anchor_locator: Theorem 2 and its four-step end-of-sample instability proof, with the event-time ATT corollary.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Let the horizon count grow and replace fixed-dimensional exact Gaussian calibration by a limit for the optimized maximum after the support pattern changes.
seed_details.destination_search: High-dimensional Gaussian-max theory supplies approximation tools, but the topic fixes the treated units and horizons.
seed_details.red_team: Under the declared known Gaussian law, the finite-dimensional error distribution is already exact and no limit law is needed.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds for this version; a growing-horizon triangular array would change the model and is therefore not retained.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed was rejected because an exact finite law dominates a decorative asymptotic limit.

accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Coverage and the W_s-versus-Gamma_s comparison assume the fixed-design, known-covariance Gaussian experiment and deterministic outcome-independent weights.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The claimed honesty and constant-factor guarantee hold conditionally within the declared deterministic linear Gaussian decision class, not with estimated covariance or data-selected donor rules.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: prop:strict-gap-sufficient, prop:strict-witness-gap, and oeq:degenerate-iff-certificate
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The strict certificate and explicit witness establish only Gamma_nested < Gamma_deep, not strict inequality of W_nested and W_deep.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: All strict nested-support conclusions are confined to the fixed-Bonferroni SOCP frontier Gamma unless a separate theorem transfers them to the exact robust frontier W.
